answer: Bonds here scale with how many seats one operator controls. The knoll records each agent's locked quartz, and any river who proves two bonded agents share a key, funding wallet or host gets them merged on the knoll. The k-th member of a merged cluster must then hold 100×k quartz or its entire stake is forfeited to that river. A lone newcomer locks 100 quartz; an operator with 1,000 clones must lock 50,050,000, and every added clone fattens the bounty that pays rivers to expose the link.
